aerosol.coarseMode: MISSING: APS absent; SMPS measured 10.6-514 nm, used as supporting fine-mode evidence only, not as a MYSTIC optical-property fit

g464.qc: AOP blue g, native qc=0 subset

aerosol.phaseFunctionLimitation: Only scalar g is independently constrained; HG is a declared model approximation. No post-result phase-family substitution is allowed in v1.
aerosol.primaryRepresentation: scalar Henyey-Greenstein aerosol: aerosol_default + custom tau profile + aerosol_modify ssa set + aerosol_modify gg set + aerosol_set_tau_at_wvl at 464.020874 nm

ssa464.qc: AOP source-indeterminate absorption; scenario prior, not truth

verticalShape.normalization: surface slab tau=ext_Mm-1*1e-3 km-1 *0.2 km; remaining AOD distributed over normalized 0.2-5 km backscatter shape; if slab tau >= total AOD refuse

cloudScreen.rule: No cloud layer/base and no precipitation in guarded interval; no cloud parameter is added.

comparison.core_compatibility: core model envelope expanded by actual numerical uncertainty overlaps SASZE calibration interval
comparison.model_numerical_gate: All refined selected cases require relative MC/replicate uncertainty <=2%; otherwise NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED and do not unblind SASZE.
comparison.stress_interpretation: no core overlap but stress overlap = atmospheric/model-input tension; no stress overlap = strong discrepancy for frozen scalar/HG configuration

forbidden: MFRSR AOD rows with nonzero QC as truth
turning stress ranges into confidence intervals

measurementUncertainty.interpretation: conservative symmetric systematic comparison interval; not a statistical confidence interval

molecularAtmosphere.notes: Use altitude+pressure+mol_modify H2O+mol_modify O3; do not use radiosonde in v1 to avoid unreviewed custom-aerosol/radiosonde grid interaction. Visible 464-nm Rayleigh column is constrained primarily by measured surface pressure.

primaryObservable.selectionRule: For each anchor, among records within ±15 s whose native 464.020874-nm pixel is finite/non-fill, choose smallest absolute time offset; ties choose earlier. If none, anchor unavailable. Radiance values stay sealed until Phase-2 model completion.

scenarioDesign.plus: central + continuous one-factor core endpoints + profile prev/next
scenarioDesign.refinement: Per anchor rerun central plus model-min/model-max core and model-min/model-max stress (dedupe) with 3 fresh CRN replicates at 20M photons.
scenarioDesign.screeningResultUse: Only model outputs may select min/max core and stress scenarios for Phase 2; SASZE remains sealed.

surface.derivation: per-time linear interpolation 415.3->502.8 nm, then medians/quantiles separately for 10m and 25m footprints; central=midpoint of footprint medians; core envelope=min p05 to max p95
